# Cresca

> Cresca is a marketing team that runs paid advertising, social media and video, and SEO as one connected system, reporting on leads and booked revenue rather than impressions. It serves two distinct client types: founders and creators building a business online, and owner-led service businesses that need local demand.

**Website:** https://cresca.agency/
**Contact:** hello@cresca.agency
**Model:** Remote-first, small client list, no long-term lock-in contracts.

## What Cresca does

- **Paid media** — Google Ads (search, local, Performance Max), Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) and TikTok Ads, built around calls and form fills, with conversion tracking and call tracking in place before spend scales.
- **Social media and video** — Social strategy plus short-form and long-form video editing and thumbnails. The same creative feeds the paid campaigns.
- **SEO and organic** — Technical SEO, keyword and content strategy, on-page work and backlinks.
- **AI automation** — Workflows for conversion tracking, attribution, automated reporting, budget and bid checks, and lead routing.

## Who it is for

Two distinct client types:

1. **Founders, CEOs, co-founders and creators building a business online** — growing an audience and a business at once. Work is social strategy, short- and long-form video, and paid social that converts attention into revenue.
2. **Owner-led service businesses that need local demand** — real-world services competing for every enquiry. Work is Google Ads, local SEO, call tracking and lead-gen landing pages, aimed at a cost per lead that leaves a margin.

Common to both: the founder still makes the marketing decisions and does not want to coordinate several separate freelancers.

Cresca is a poor fit for buyers choosing purely on lowest price, for those wanting execution-only hands with strategy left to them, or for anyone needing results within a week on tracking that was never set up.

## Regions served

Germany, Austria and Switzerland (DACH), the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand. Work is conducted in English; German-language campaigns and landing pages are also handled for DACH accounts.

## Verifiable figures

- Over €1M in ad spend managed; ~€900K optimised by the paid media lead.
- 65+ client accounts run.
- 150M+ views generated for creator and brand clients; 500+ videos shipped.
- Roughly a decade of combined team experience.
- Figures are in euros because most managed spend to date has been in the DACH market.

Live, anonymised Google Ads dashboards are published on the site as evidence (client identifiers removed, numbers untouched).

## Where the paid-media track record comes from

Most managed ad spend to date has run in competitive German service verticals: moving and relocation; house clearance and disposal (Entrümpelung, Auflösung, Entsorgung); home and trade services (Handwerker, Bau); cleaning and facility services (Reinigung, Gebäudeservice); automotive and vehicle services; health and clinics.

These verticals are the evidence base for the paid-media discipline, not a restriction on who Cresca accepts as a client. The creator- and founder-facing work is evidenced separately by 150M+ views generated and 500+ videos shipped.

## Pricing

No published rate card. Pricing depends on which services are needed, the number of markets, and the ad budget under management. Ad spend is paid directly to the platforms and is separate from fees. A free 30-minute assessment call ends with a scoped figure.
